_evidence: Car block (esi) read by 0x00426261 (called by 0x00426320) and its helper 0x00426216: byte +0x26b (test 0x80: set returns 0), word +0xa2 (movzx; 0x4000 - x clamped at 0), word +0x66 (movsx, subtracted from count<<14), dword +0x19c (imul [0x602b4c] shrd 28, -0x14, clamp 0) and word +0xba (movzx, imul shrd 14). Only imul/shrd/compares: every value is valid. The lead count (res+0x2000)>>14 of 0x426320 is nonzero only when the product chain is large, which random words almost never give, so these draw from lists mixing zero, Q14 unit values and extremes (bit 7 of +0x26b set in 1/5); the rest of the block is random.
